Correct portalled dialog

On load there is no dialog. Clicking #openMenu portals one into <body> as its last child, marks the rest of the page aria-hidden="true", and traps focus inside it with guard spans — the pattern Base UI, Radix, Headless UI and floating-ui all ship, and the pattern :modal does not match.

A link behind the sheet, which a Tab walk must never reach while it is open

Nothing here is a defect. See the portalled-dialog entry in manifest.json for what may and may not fire in the open state.
